caption: The drawing depicts a lidded goblet rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite on a plain, light-colored background. The goblet consists of a rounded lid with a knobbed finial, a wide cup that tapers downward, and a thick, ornate stem that broadens into a stable, circular foot. The lid fits snugly onto the rim of the goblet, and both the lid and the bowl show detailed shading to convey their reflective, possibly glass or metal surface. On the body of the cup, there is an elaborate decorative motif that includes a central circular or oval blank shield or cartouche, surrounded by ornate scrollwork, foliage, and what appears to be two lion-like creatures or supporters flanking the central design. There is also a hint of cursive writing or inscription around the upper edge of the cup, following the curve of the rim. The structure has a symmetrical, balanced composition and the intricate details are predominantly focused on the upper part of the goblet. The drawing is highly detailed, emphasizing the reflective surface and three-dimensional shape of the vessel.
title: Glass
